text:
mira: bringing up kestrel9b-int4 from modelhub for summarization evals — quick sanity run shows ~7% ROUGE-L drop vs fp16 baseline. anyone seen a similar int4 hallucination/regression pattern? :thinking:

 tj: two things to check first: tokenizer index mapping and any token-id offsets during conversion. often punctuation/class tokens shift by +1.

 mira: good call. converter logs looked clean but i did notice BOS id mismatch on a couple examples. sample diff below:
```
orig_tokens: [50256, 11, 784, 102]
converted:   [50255, 11, 784, 102]
note: only on strings with leading unicode marker.
```

 olga: also verify rotary params — kestrel-paper mentions headwise scale factor (per-head freq) different from our other LLMs. int4 export might be folding the scale into the kernel incorrectly. run the inspector: `python tools/inspect_rotary.py --model out/kestrel/ --compare fp16` to dump head scales.

 kevin: ran a quick kv-cache-replay with the failing prompt set. divergence at token 4 consistently. clipboard of the trace: 
```
# step 3 output (fp16): "The shipment arrived on"
# step 3 output (int4): "The shipment arreved on"
# logits diverge: token 189 vs 190 for 'v' vs 'w' class
```

 ci-bot: benchmark job #kestrel-int4-12 finished — fp16 rouge_l=0.62, kestrel-int4=0.575, p50 latency down 8% :white_check_mark:

 mira: plan of action:
 1) tj: run tokenizer roundtrip on 1k english samples and dump mismatches (tokens + strings).
 2) olga: add per-head rotary-scale diff visualizer and KV-cache state diff for the divergent examples.
 3) kevin: try re-quant using symmetric per-channel quant (and try disabling folding of rotary into weights).
 4) if token-id offsets found, bisect converter commits and test minimal repro.

 tj: taking tokenizer checks now. pls drop 200 sample files into s3://redwood-onboard/kestrel/sanity_inputs/ and i'll start.

 olga: i'll push a small script to tools/rotary_diag and add a notebook to visualize headwise scale deltas. will ping when ready.

 kevin: if converter is the culprit i suspect an off-by-one in the patch for unicode normalization. will run a bisect tomorrow morning.

 mira: :thumbsup: i'll open an issue with the sample failing prompts + attach CI artifacts. tagging @eng-ml for visibility.

 tj: quick Q — do we have any known models that use "alternate-rotary-normalization" flag? might be a parameter in the ckpt.

 olga: Kestrel's config has `rotary_variant: headwise_scale_v2` — iirc we added best-effort support but didn't test against int4 carefully. that's likely the smoking gun.

 kevin: ok i'll iterate on quant config and try `--disable-rotary-fold` in conversion to see if parity returns. will post results in this thread.

 mira: thanks all — let's sync in #eng-ml-standup tomorrow if we have new numbers.
